note: Facts that fell out of the Spirit Masters scrapbook sweep (TopSCHOLAR stu_org). Not hunted for.

volumes.title: Spirit Masters Scrapbook, 1994-95
volumes.verdict: No display board of named studio headshots. p. 4 carries a printed 'Congratulations 1994-95 Spirit Masters' name list of 24 with a collage of cut-out candid snapshots around it; the names are not set against the faces, so the page identifies nobody. Portraits: spent.

volumes.title: Spirit Masters Scrapbook, spring/summer 1986
volumes.verdict: OPENED AND SPENT. No class composite board of any kind, and no printed roster. Forty-one leaves of loose colour snapshots pasted four to six a page, nearly all uncaptioned. The only named material is a two-page 'Our Officers' spread at pp. 10-11 where the names are hand-lettered beside individual snapshots: Laura McClellan Chairman 1985, Louise Gilchrist Secretary (her mounting corners are empty, the photograph was never pasted in), Barkley Payne Public Relations and Spirit Master of the year for 1985, Tommy Clayton Parliamentarian, Leslie Moseley Treasurer, Kelly Ford and Ursula Thomas Historians, David Newman, and the incoming pair for 1986, Cindy Smith Chairman and Jim Robinson Vice-Chairman. Every one of those eleven names was checked against all 1,858 people in years.json by surname, and not one is in the SGA record: there is no Gilchrist, McClellan, Moseley, Clayton or Farrior in the archive at all, the Paynes, Fords, Newmans, Thomases, Smiths and Robinsons on file are other people in other decades. Portraits for SGA: none. The rest of the volume is newspaper clippings (the Coke Classic story, Sweet Sixteen, Kern Alexander sworn in as WKU's seventh president) and registration paperwork.

volumes.title: Spirit Masters Scrapbook, 2001-02
volumes.verdict: OPENED, AND THE RICHEST OF THE NINE. The composite is not a display board but the official printed WKU Spirit Masters brochure for 2001-2002, cut into cards and pasted across pp. 38-39: each card carries two colour studio portraits side by side with the name, home town, class standing and major printed directly beneath its own portrait, so name and face are one printed unit. The mapping is provable card by card: on five of the eleven cards exactly one man is named and exactly one man is pictured, and the sexes agree every time, with no contradiction anywhere on the two sheets. p. 37 carries the same class again as a photographed display poster, 'Western Kentucky University Spirit Masters Class of 2001-2002', at a much smaller scale; the brochure is the better source and was used. Five faces and two upgrades came off it. The volume also holds a full-page SGA election poster on p. 75 and the Herald's election result on p. 76.

volumes.title: Spirit Masters Scrapbook, 1996-97
volumes.verdict: REOPENED AND FINISHED. A predecessor worked only the individual portrait pages, pp. 7-17, where one or two mounted colour studio prints a page each carry a typed nameplate on card beneath their own frame, and took five faces off them. Two things on the volume had not been opened. p. 3 is the CLASS COMPOSITE BOARD photographed whole, twenty-three red-matted studio portraits ringing a central card reading 'Western Kentucky University / Spirit Masters / 1996-1997', each portrait with its own separate red-matted nameplate directly beneath it; it is the only place Scott Self's face survives, because the individual page for him, p. 13, is an empty pink mat plated 'Scott Self, Parliamentarian'. pp. 21-22 are the printed 1996-1997 class brochure pasted in whole, twenty-four black and white halftone portraits with name, home town, class and major printed beneath each; it is the only place Lance Barnhouse survives, he being the one member the board omits. Between them the volume is now exhausted: every one of the twenty-four names has been checked against all 1,858 people in years.json and the eight who are in the SGA record all have a face.

volumes.title: Spirit Masters Scrapbook, 2004-05
volumes.verdict: REOPENED AND FINISHED. The class board is photographed in two halves at pp. 4 and 5, headed 'Spirit Masters' and 'Class of 2004-05', and carries twenty-nine colour studio headshots in one alphabetical chevron from Barnett to Whitfield, each with name, class, major and home town hand-lettered beside it. A predecessor took four faces off it. Every one of the twenty-nine names has now been checked against all 1,858 people in years.json: only six are in the SGA record, and the four the predecessor took plus Brittany Fausey, who already carries a crop from this same board, plus Abby Lovan, upgraded on this pass from a 146 by 255 Herald thumbnail, account for all of them. The volume is spent for portraits. HOW THE BOARD PAIRS, for anyone who reopens it: no two portraits sit at the same height, every caption is lettered level with its own portrait, and the caption goes to the left or the right of the portrait depending only on where there was clear red space, so vertical position is the whole of the proof and it is unambiguous. Abby Lovan's reading was checked independently against the Herald frame the archive already held and the two are plainly the same woman.

volumes.title: Spirit Masters Scrapbook, 1989-90
volumes.verdict: REWORKED AND NOW FINISHED. The class composite is at p. 4, headed 'THE SPIRIT MASTERS', twenty-four cards cut from the printed brochure and mounted separately on a blue ground, each card carrying one black and white studio portrait with that person's name, home town, class and major set directly beneath it. A predecessor took five faces off it (Joe Leffert, Janie Price, Paul Sagun, John Seiber, Daryl Pepper) and stopped. All twenty-four names have now been checked against all 1,858 people in years.json. Eleven of the twenty-four are in the SGA record and the six the predecessor did not take all already had a face, but five of those faces were poor and have been upgraded on this pass: Dwight Adkins and Jeff Welch from 140 by 182 Talisman grid cells, Dan Knowles from a Herald front page so broken up the eyes are unreadable, Amos Gott, a president, from a coarse front-page halftone, and Eddie Smith, with a caveat recorded on his entry. Michael Colvin already has a 1238 by 1201 Talisman portrait and was left alone. THE REST OF THE VOLUME: seventy leaves, no other board of named portraits and no SGA roster or minutes of any kind. p. 3 is the printed 'Congratulations to the 1989-1890 Spirit Masters' name list, the same twenty-four; p. 5 is the Hilltopics feature naming them again in running text; p. 33 carries the university's Board of Regents portrait grid, on which the student regent that year would be Amos Gott, but the faces are postage-stamp size and he is better served by the composite; p. 44-45 is the 1990 Student Awards Presentation programme, which is departmental awards only and names no SGA officer.

volumes.title: Spirit Masters Scrapbook, 2011-12
volumes.verdict: OPENED AND SPENT. The last of the nine scrapbooks and the only modern one. No composite board, no named individual portraits, no roster. Twenty-five leaves of scrapbooked group snapshots with hand-lettered event captions: the retreat, the banquet, Homecoming, the Halloween and Christmas parties, Leap Day, Naples. p. 3 is the class group photograph of about forty people with no names. The only named faces in the volume are six Homecoming Queen and King campaign posters pasted onto pp. 12-13, Alex Kimura, Rachel Gumble, Ashleigh Miller, Kelley Boothe, Kaylee Epperson and Hunter Stevens; none of the six is in years.json. This is consistent with the separate finding in _archive-gaps.json that the 2011-2018 Spirit Masters class BOOKLETS hold none of the archive's people, and it closes the scrapbook series as well.

volumes.title: NOT A SPIRIT MASTERS VOLUME
volumes.verdict: A warning for the next pass, because the Spirit Masters scrapbooks otherwise run unbroken from stu_org/321 to 329 and it is natural to assume 325 is one of them. It is not. stu_org/325 is 'UA68/9/2/2 Big Red Marching Band Newsletter' (1998), article 1328. There are nine Spirit Masters scrapbooks, not ten, at 321, 322, 323, 324, 326, 327, 328 and 329, which is eight; the ninth is elsewhere in the collection or the count of nine in an earlier note was wrong. Do not spend a download on 325.

facts.body: p. 14 of the 1994-95 Spirit Masters scrapbook is headed, in hand lettering, 'SPIRIT MASTERS IN STUDENT GOVERNMENT', and pastes in a printed roster sheet titled '1994 - 1995 CONGRESS MEMBERS' with the Spirit Masters among them picked out in yellow highlighter. It is a contemporaneous membership list for the whole 1994-95 Congress.
facts.caveats: Jason Vincent is on a separate slip pasted over the gap between the two printed columns, so he was added by hand to the printed sheet. Carlene Lodmell and Darlene Lodmell are both on it, side by side, which is independent support for the settled ruling that they are two people. The list also shows the 1994-95 spelling 'Steven Roadcap' and 'Shawna Whartenby'.

facts.topic: SGA executive election of 9-10 April 2002, full result
facts.body: The Herald's report of the spring 2002 executive election is pasted into the Spirit Masters scrapbook at p. 76, headed 'Sears wins election in landslide / Stinson defeated by 690 votes', by Molly O'Connor. Candidates waited in the SGA office and had the result shortly after midnight, at 12.15 a.m., online voting having closed fifteen minutes earlier. Outgoing president Leslie Bedo announced it. Scott Taylor, the student activities and organizations director, came by the office afterwards to congratulate the winners.
results: President: Jamie Sears 1,284, defeating Sam Stinson 594
Executive Vice President: John Bradley 1,065, defeating Dana Lockhart 730
Vice President of Administration: Brandon Copeland, defeating Patti Johnson 1,106 to 761
Vice President of Finance: Ross Pruitt, unopposed, 1,524 votes
Vice President of Public Relations: Anna Coats, defeating Holly Skidmore 933 to 809, a margin of 124
facts.photo_caption: Jamie Sears, right, embraces Henderson senior Joe Loney after hearing she was elected; Ross Pruitt in the middle. Credit Edward Linsmier/Herald.
facts.note: All nine people named already have a portrait in the archive except Dana Lockhart, who is recorded only as an At-Large member sworn in 30 January 2001 and is not in the photograph.
